pages.title: Humus Surface Marking
pages.text: Forest humus now participates more completely in planting, landslides, and map display. When a kaolin deposit generates inside humus terrain, a layer of kaolin clay grass is added so the deposit is not completely hidden beneath ordinary humus.

pages.title: Generation Boundary
pages.text: This cover applies only to forest humus that already meets kaolin generation conditions; it does not create kaolin in deep oceans or unsuitable biomes. Humus keeps its forest-soil uses and natural transitions, and the change appears only in new chunks.
